Equips and supports hospitals in low- and middle-income countries to give oxygen therapy, chiefly for children with pneumonia. Ambitious Impact published one public model of its work; the most recent, from January 2024, puts it at **<span data-figure="headline" data-model="oxygen-access-project-aim">5.7</span> years of healthy life per $1,000**.

| Model | By | Date | Years of healthy life per $1,000 | Cells reproduced |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Oxygen Access Project: oxygen for childhood pneumonia (Ambitious Impact, 2023 idea report, cost-effectiveness analysis updated 2024)](/oxygen-access-project) | AIM | January 2024 | <span data-figure="headline" data-model="oxygen-access-project-aim">5.7</span> | 311 |

**Purely theoretical.** Ambitious Impact's estimate is of the idea, written before Oxygen Access Project existed, not of the charity's own results. It is shown because Oxygen Access Project runs the programme today ([checked October 2026](https://www.oxygenaccessproject.org)) and no model of its actual work exists yet.
